A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Markovian CoT research. Their main text, equations, figures, and appendices are readable and can be matched despite substantial rewriting and reformatting.

before.justification: v4 reports original arithmetic, GSM8K, and Wikipedia experiments, including perturbation tests, cross-model evaluations, and generated-text examples.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experimental results and qualitative examples across the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The CoT bottleneck, frozen predictor, trainable state updater, informativeness objective, and TEI/PG/PPO approaches remain. Rewritten explanations and relocated implementation details do not establish a changed training or inference procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate fifteen-term addition, GSM8K reasoning, and Wikipedia continuation, including the same perturbation and transfer scenarios. Human studies and multi-turn dialogue remain proposed future work.

E2.justification: Figure 2 retains TEI, PG, and PPO comparisons. Pretrained baselines and the Llama, Mistral, GPT2, and Phi transfer evaluators also match. DeepSeek-R1 and question-plus-CoT alternatives receive expanded discussion in v5 Appendix D but are explicitly not evaluated.

E3.justification: The reported token budgets, model assignments, metrics, and perturbation procedures match after including v4 Appendices A–B. v5 explicitly reports GSM8K sampling temperature 2.0, but this supplements previously unspecified information rather than revising a stated setting.

E4.justification: Arithmetic and Wikipedia perturbation analyses, cross-model transfer analyses, and both qualitative case studies are retained. The Wikipedia analyses move into the main text, while arithmetic perturbation and GSM8K transfer plots move to Appendix A; these are not new analyses.

E5.justification: Repeated-run reporting is retained, including four-run pointwise maxima for arithmetic optimization, three GSM8K runs, four Wikipedia training runs, and six-run Wikipedia transfer averages. Neither version adds confidence intervals, significance tests, or seed disclosures relative to the other.

E6.justification: All seven embedded plot images are identical across versions. Section 5 retains GSM8K accuracy of 35.94% rising to 69.14%, the other runs' 58.23% and 62.85%, and Wikipedia accuracy of 8.2% rising to 10.5%. The qualitative examples and Wikipedia case-study reward of 0.3438 also match.

T1.justification: v5 Section 4.1 separates observation length N from CoT length K, replacing v4's shared-length specialization and formalizing the already discussed compression condition. v4's explicit trajectory policy-gradient identity and Monte Carlo estimator, Equations 5–6, are omitted. The central reward and informativeness objective remain.

C1.justification: The four central contributions and headline GSM8K result remain. However, v5's introduction no longer explicitly claims that training produces a minimal-length, complete CoT containing every necessary step; it emphasizes CoT sufficiency and recipient-specific compression.

C2.justification: v5 explicitly acknowledges model-centric proxies for human interpretability, outlines human prediction studies, and adds a GPT2-based argument against sophisticated steganography. Appendix D expands compute, tuning, and architecture reasons for missing comparisons. Conversely, the Bentham-based caution that robustness might reflect accuracy is removed.

D1.justification: v5 adds an explicit repository link and explicitly specifies GSM8K sampling temperature. Most LoRA, clipping, accumulation, prompt, and reward-baseline details already appear in v4's appendices and are consolidated in the main text. v4's explicit statement that PPO also uses threshold-based sample selection is omitted.

R1.justification: v5 adds STaR and DeepSeek-R1 positioning and citations for RLHF and Constitutional AI. It removes the state-space-model comparison, Ranaldi–Freitas distillation comparison, and Bentham discussion. These update the surrounding comparisons while retaining the central distinction of predicting from CoT without the original question.

P1.justification: The abstract, introduction, related work, formalism, methods explanations, discussion, and baseline appendix are extensively rewritten. Stability guidance moves into Section 4.3, dedicated Future Work and Acknowledgements sections appear, and the appendices are reorganized.

P2.justification: The main text changes from a single-column layout to a two-column conference format. v4 Figures 7–8 become v5 Figures 4–5, while v4 Figures 4–6 are resized and combined as Figure 6a–c in Appendix A. Captions and figure placement change substantially, although the underlying plots remain identical.

improvement.justification: The explicit repository link, clearer GSM8K settings, consolidated implementation guidance, and explicit distinction between proxy evidence and human validation modestly improve reproducibility and clarity. Separating observation and CoT lengths also improves the formal specification. These gains are tempered by removal of the explicit gradient-estimator formulas and some critical related-work context; the experimental evidence remains unchanged.
